name: Demon Academia
source: An ordinary young man suddenly finds himself connected to the demon. Through a mysterious event, he realizes that he has a unique bond with the reincarnated demon—and he becomes entangled in their fate.
translation: 一个普通的年轻人突然发现自己与恶魔联系在一起。通过一次神秘事件，他意识到自己与转世的恶魔有着独特的联系，并与他们的命运纠缠在一起。
